notes.title: The Ramsey 1.061
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790745/ca50e2667763f8c429074af7f48cf71c84aee8cd.png[/img]

Hello! Here's an update from The Ramsey. (Ver. 1.061)

- The translation of some NPC's Japanese lines in Acorn Town has been modified.
- Fixed a bug where the next map move was not going right in certain areas of the Crystal Cave.

notes.title: The Ramsey 1.06
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790745/ca50e2667763f8c429074af7f48cf71c84aee8cd.png[/img]

Hello! Here's 1.06 update news from The Ramsey. We've fixed bugs and added new features for more comfortable gameplay!

Language:
- adjusted Japanese font to be more clearly

Controller:
- adjusted Y-axis sensitivity of left analogue stick less sensitive
- now vibration occur when Ramsey hops onto the cotton popcorn

Bug fixed:
- bug showing incorrect location of flag icon on Sherbet Island's minimap

notes.title: The Ramsey 1.0.5
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42790745/ca50e2667763f8c429074af7f48cf71c84aee8cd.png[/img]

In version 1.05 of The Ramsey, we've fixed a few bugs and added new features.

Hidden Endings Bonus
  - Save slots with a record of viewing a Hidden Ending are marked with a flower icon.
  - If you have a save with a hidden ending, all entries in the Journal will be unlocked. 

Settings
  - Voice: If you turn the volume down to the minimum, a beep sound will be played to accompany your dialog. 
    (The volume of the beeps follows the volume of the SE).

Bug fixes
  - Fixed a bug where map movement would not work correctly in certain sections of Insect Island.
  - Fixed a bug where the ending could become unavailable after clearing the final boss in certain situations.
  - Fixed an issue where Journal data would not load properly.

notes.title: The Ramsey 1.04
notes.content:
New mode added 
- 'Wildlife' : Battle with tougher, and harder boss. The map does not show hints.

notes.title: The Ramsey 1.02
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42790745/ca50e2667763f8c429074af7f48cf71c84aee8cd.png[/img]

In version 1.02 of The Ramsey, we've fixed a few bugs and added new features.

- You can now go back and see unexplored areas after finishing the last boss fight.
- Added an event to talk to Cherry on Sherbet Island.
- Fixed a recognition issue when multiple gamepads are connected and disconnected.
- Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: The Ramsey 1.01
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42790745/ca50e2667763f8c429074af7f48cf71c84aee8cd.png[/img]

In version 1.01 of The Ramsey, we've fixed a few bugs and added new features.

- Added a teleporter: Have you seen the special event that happens at the end of the game? If you haven't, try to defeat the final boss after creating 8 inventions.
- Fixed typos in Japanese and English text.
- Fixed map movement not working properly in some areas.
- Minor bug fixes.
